claims.closure: Exact algebra for the declared normalized forms with common Gamma_0: Gamma_C(u)=Gamma_A(sqrt(u))=sqrt(u)/(1+sqrt(u)). This does not establish a physical identity across all Gamma sources or regimes; the source aliases and common physical normalization remain a provenance/model-mapping issue.
claims.atomization: Atomic at the normalized-form scope; keep physical identity and cross-package normalization as separate v3.2 claims.
claims.overlap_contradiction: No algebraic contradiction. The only boundary is between normalized function identity and physical unification.

claims.closure: Exact algebra in the dimensionless declared representation: Gamma_B(u)=sqrt(u)Gamma_A(u)=u^(3/2)/(1+u). Gamma_B diverges as sqrt(u) at high u while A saturates; that functional difference is not by itself a phase identification or a physical cross-source identity.
claims.atomization: Atomic at the normalized-form scope; asymptotic interpretation and physical phase assignment remain separate questions.
claims.overlap_contradiction: No contradiction in the algebra. Any contradiction arises only if the asymptotic difference is promoted to a phase claim.

claims.closure: The declared Gamma sources use overlapping positive density domains in the shared coordinate u=rho/rho_crit, not disjoint u intervals. No source supplies u->S or u->L0-L3 mapping, so no physical phase identification or common measurand is established.
claims.atomization: Keep the source-level density-domain classification separate from the unresolved u-to-S regime mapping in v3.2.
claims.overlap_contradiction: Overlap is supported only in the declared u coordinate. The absence of u->S mapping blocks the stronger phase interpretation.

claims.closure: The executed beta omits r_* although the source documentation includes it. With the implemented beta and default Planck l_g, x^2/u=4*pi/(3*l_g)=2.592073146526232e35 m^-1 rather than 1; x is therefore not dimensionless in the stated SI convention. The code-level answer is established, but physical intent and canonical normalization remain unresolved.
claims.atomization: v3.2: G2a.1 whether executed beta contains r_*; G2a.2 computed x^2/u; G2a.3 dimensional validity and intended unit convention.
claims.overlap_contradiction: Advocate correctly notes that the source/code comparison is answerable. Attacker correctly identifies the dimensional defect. Neither establishes the intended physical normalization.

claims.closure: The equality condition is beta=G_N*l_g. Under documented beta=4*pi*G_N*r_*/3 this requires l_g=4*pi*r_*/3; under the implemented beta it formally requires l_g=4*pi/3, incompatible with the declared length unless an unstated unit convention is introduced. The repository does not declare a canonical relation.
claims.atomization: v3.2: G2b.1 equality condition; G2b.2 repository declaration status; G2b.3 canonical r_*/l_g and unit convention.
claims.overlap_contradiction: The algebraic condition is determined, but the canonical normalization is open. Caller-supplied l_g does not establish intended physical identity.

claims.closure: The inventory contains 1.2e-10 m/s^2 as imported/SPARC/MOND-scale input and local declaration; 1.1e-10 as an external Verlinde comparator; 6.5e-10 as an unsealed EFC flag; 6.45888e-10 as C^2*a0_base; 9.469e-10 as c^2*sqrt(Lambda); 5.09684e-9 as C^2*c^2*sqrt(Lambda); 6.54392e-10 as a derived cH0 reference; an unpersisted SPARC fit interval; and dimensionless lattice test inputs. The stored 3.8e-3 (km/s)^2/kpc is a confirmed latent unit error, not an equivalent representation of 1.2e-10 m/s^2.
claims.atomization: v3.2: split each physical value into its own provenance claim, split derived/rescaled values from inputs, and add a separate unit-consistency claim. Do not bundle enumeration with canonicality.
claims.overlap_contradiction: The inventory is supported, but the values are heterogeneous. The two verified unit defects are latent because source verification found no downstream consumers.

claims.closure: 1.2e-10 m/s^2 is locally declared or frozen in several packages and shared configuration, but no repository-wide canonical physical a0 is frozen. The repository carries mixed input, measurement, declaration, inheritance, rescaling, fit, Lambda, and cH0 provenance; a0_eff must remain separate.
claims.atomization: Keep local package freeze, repository-wide canonical freeze, and a0_eff separation as distinct v3.2 status claims if a release decision is required.
claims.overlap_contradiction: Local freeze declarations do not contradict the finding that repository-wide canonical freeze is absent.

claims.closure: Repository-scoped classification is supported: C=2.32 is a numerically converged lattice measurement/extrapolation, with the sequence 2.443 -> 2.354 -> 2.320, not an analytic Watson-integral or cubic-lattice Green-function derivation. It is not shown as a statistical chi-square fit, and no documented continuum-limit error model or independent analytic chain is present.
claims.atomization: Atomic at the repository-status scope; keep numerical convergence, analytic provenance, and continuum-limit error control separate if promoted to v3.2.
claims.overlap_contradiction: The advocate's upgrade is accepted for the classification requested. Numerical convergence must not be relabeled as an analytic constant or independent physical derivation.

claims.closure: The near-match is explained only as shared declared ancestry or algebraic construction: a0_eff=C^2*a0_base, cH0 is derived from H0 and c, and 6.5e-10 is an unsealed atlas flag. It is not an independent determination or independent bridge. The Lambda_cosmo unit defect is confirmed but latent because it has no live downstream consumer.
claims.atomization: Keep shared ancestry, independent determination, numerical equality, and calibration/units as separate predicates if this claim is expanded.
claims.overlap_contradiction: The attacker correctly rejects independent-bridge language, but its seeded provenance means it is adversarial material rather than independent reviewer evidence.

claims.closure: The chain must be split: grid-action -> mode-response is formally verified under the declared Euler-Lagrange/WKB regime; mode-response -> Bose-Einstein is declared because the bosonic ensemble is assumed; BE -> RAR is declared and conditional on x=sqrt(g/a0), not an independently derived physical or empirical bridge. The later covariant and observational links are not closed by this claim.
claims.atomization: v3.2: B1.1 grid-action -> mode-response; B1.2 mode-response -> BE; B1.3 BE -> RAR; keep covariant-action and likelihood transitions as separate claims.
claims.overlap_contradiction: The advocate correctly narrows the claim to the named three transitions. The bundle cannot receive a fully closed status because its edges have different types.

claims.closure: The covariant classical correction increases with g, while the proposed dimensionless mu_BE(g) decreases with g and tends toward zero at high acceleration. The source explicitly treats mu_BE as postulated rather than derived from the classical action. This is a verified trend/derivation break for that edge, not a whole-theory falsification; the compared objects are not identical typed functions.
claims.atomization: v3.2: B2.1 classical g trend; B2.2 mu_BE g trend; B2.3 derived versus postulated status; B2.4 typed-object comparability.
claims.overlap_contradiction: The edge from covariant EFT to mu_BE is contradicted as a classical derivation. The claim bundle is not itself a universal contradiction of EFC.

claims.closure: The quantities are not identified as one typed object. Gamma in box(phi)=Gamma(rho) requires units [phi]L^-2 and a declared phi normalization; dS/drho is negative for the coded entropy derivative; the per-mode code returns a positive absolute value and lacks d rho/dt needed for a T^-1 rate. No phi-to-S map, entropy normalization, time normalization, or consistent r_*/l_g map closes the identity.
claims.atomization: v3.2: B3.1 Gamma_box units/form; B3.2 dS/drho sign and units; B3.3 per-mode coefficient versus rate; B3.4 typed identity map and time normalization.
claims.overlap_contradiction: The sign/unit mismatch blocks the naive identification, but absence of a typed map is not a universal proof that no future mapping can exist.

claims.closure: sqrt(g_acc) is an acceleration-dependent mode-energy scaling factor, whereas sqrt(-g_metric) is the metric-determinant volume-measure factor. They are different objects; no source supplies an identification between them.
claims.atomization: Atomic typed-object distinction; any proposed operator mapping between them belongs to a separate covariant-reduction claim.
claims.overlap_contradiction: The shared symbol g is misleading, but the definitions and roles are not contradictory.

claims.closure: EFC -> LCDM is supported as an atlas/framework formal-limit declaration at L0/L1, not as an equation-level reduction or equal-footing empirical recovery. Reported f_sigma8 is EFC 0.430 versus LCDM 0.449 in one ledger block and 0.452 in another. A reduced same-data run exists, but the full native joint likelihood/MCMC and holdout are not executed.
claims.atomization: v3.2: L1.1 formal-limit classification; L1.2 exact f_sigma8 source/value; L1.3 equal-footing likelihood execution; L1.4 holdout recovery.
claims.overlap_contradiction: The advocate is right that the declaration and readback can be classified. The open likelihood gate prevents promotion to empirical recovery.

claims.closure: EFC -> MOND is supported only as a declared deep-MOND/formal-limit relation and phenomenological RAR overlap. MOND uses 1.2e-10 m/s^2 while the EFC atlas value 6.5e-10 is unsealed; a0_eff and other candidates remain unresolved. No exact full mu(x) reduction or equal-footing SPARC/RAR likelihood/holdout has been executed.
claims.atomization: v3.2: L2.1 formal-limit declaration; L2.2 EFC/MOND a0 values and provenance; L2.3 mu(x) mathematical reduction; L2.4 common-nuisance likelihood and holdout.
claims.overlap_contradiction: The atlas declaration and L3 overlap are real, but they do not constitute mathematical identity or empirical recovery.

The Gamma aliases are not literal common identifiers across all source packages. A v3.2 provenance claim should freeze the source-to-alias map, normalization, measurand, and regime namespace.
The two confirmed unit defects, a0_kpc and Lambda_cosmo, are latent because source verification found no live downstream consumers, but they must be repaired before any numerical a0 bridge is used.
The five discriminator designs are not evidence nodes until their measurement chains, frozen parameters, likelihoods, and holdouts are executed.
